about_the_game:
• You become the administrator of a mysterious underground shelter—a former nuclear fallout facility now dedicated to containing supernatural entities.

  • Your primary mission is to infiltrate sites of paranormal outbreaks and neutralize their eerie, terrifying origins.

  • Upon entering an anomaly zone, you will receive a Crimson Inscription. Prioritize completing its tasks, or face horrifying consequences.

  • You may form a team with companions for safety, though teamwork might bring chaos as much as security (x_x!).

  • Return loot to the shelter to upgrade its infrastructure, enhance gear/weapons, and improve efficiency for future Crimson Inscription missions.

  • Capture supernatural entities, imprison them in specialized containment devices, and—if desired—assign them as laborers to contribute to your shelter’s operations.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
